channel.title: Joe — Security Intelligence
channel.description: Cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, breaches, and Microsoft security updates.

item.title: 🔴 Gyazo server flaw exploited to steal 23.6 million user records
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — review monitoring and incident-response readiness.
The Gyazo image-sharing platform has confirmed it suffered a data breach after hackers exploited a server vulnerability that allowed them to steal 23.6 million user records. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 14h

item.title: 🔴 In Other News: Ransomware Developer Sentenced, Plugin4Shell AI Attack, Critical SAP Flaw
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups, endpoint protection, and recovery readiness.

Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Mandiant's 2026 AI risk report, PhantomRaven malware used by bug bounty hunter, WordPress plugin bug exploited.

item.title: 🟠 CVE-2026-88097 Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
item.description:
Why this matters: Security-relevant development — confirm exposure and mitigation status.

Use after free in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.



Source: Microsoft Security Response Center  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 17h

item.title: 🟠 Microsoft Patches CVSS 10.0 Azure AI Foundry Flaw Enabling Unauthorized Privilege Escalation
item.description:
Why this matters: Privilege-escalation risk — review local admin and endpoint controls.
Microsoft has released fixes for a maximum-severity security flaw in Azure AI Foundry that could be exploited to achieve privilege escalation. No customer action is required. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-85889, carries a CVSS score of 10.0. "Missing authentication for critical function in Azure AI Foundry allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network,"

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 18h

item.title: 🔴 CVE-2026-69671 Microsoft Office Word Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description:
